title: Round properly
description:
`static_cast<int>(2.7)` gives `2`: it chops, it does not round. Write `int roundToInt(double x)` that rounds to the **nearest** whole number.

```cpp
roundToInt(2.7)    // 3
roundToInt(2.2)    // 2
roundToInt(-2.7)   // -3
```

`std::round` in `<cmath>` rounds, but hands back a `double`.
